text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonia to participate in the Balkan ministerial conference in Thessaloniki on June 9-10. The name problem to be resolved by compromise.

- Several thousand Albanians demonstrated on Saturday after the Macedonian constitutional court's decision that the flags of neighbouring countries should not be raised in front of local municipal institutions in Gostivar and Tetovo.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov says to Ljubljana daily Vecer that "the price of reforms is lower if they are conducted rapidly".
- Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski told Macedonian Radio that "the battle against organised crime is assuming proportions of a 'free for all' hunt, without real arguments".

- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski to make thorough reconstruction of the government. According to reliable party sources from the SDAM meeting Sunday, "the foreign minister Ljubomir Frckoski and transport minister Dimitar Buzlevski to be replaced. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
